classification.difficultyReason: Several linked decisions using the demonstrated definitions or procedures. The difference of squares exposes x+5 and x−5; x−2 cancels but its original divisor-zero restriction remains visible under the approved domain decision.

answer.short:
$\dfrac5{x-5}$, $x\ne-5,2,5$.

Multiply by the reciprocal, then factorise and cancel.
answer.worked:
The original denominators exclude $x=-5,5$. The divisor must also be nonzero, so $x\ne2$.
$$\begin{align*}\frac{5x-10}{x^2-25}\div\frac{x-2}{x+5}&=\frac{5(x-2)}{(x-5)(x+5)}\times\frac{x+5}{x-2}\\\frac{5x-10}{x^2-25}\div\frac{x-2}{x+5}&=\frac5{x-5}.\end{align*}$$
Domain: $x\ne-5,2,5$.
